QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] Permeating Blades
QuestInfo.2: You have completed your assignment for the week. Talk to #p2230000# at #m241000220# again next week to receive a new weekly quest.

0.0: Hi there, buddy! Heading home after a hard day of helping out #p2230000# and #p2230001#? You sure are swell!\r\nUmm, by the way... could you do me a teeny-tiny favor? I'll give you an Anti-Magic Stone if you do!\r\n

yes.0: We've really got to do something about #m241000225# and #m241000224#. The #o8630010# and #o8630011# monsters are running amok, slicing up anyone who passes by!
yes.1: Cut down the #b#o8630010##k and #b#o8630011##k populations by #b300 each#k. They appear in #b#m241000225##k and #b#m241000224##k.\r\n#r(Caution! This quest will reset at midnight on Sunday.)#k

no.0: Oh, I understand. You should rest. You've been working real hard, after all! If you change your mind, I'll be here... always...

1.0: Did you really defeat 300 #o8630010# and #o8630011# monsters? That comes out to 600! Astonishing! Here, I think you earned this Anti-Magic Stone.

yes.0: There's absolutely nothing left for you to do today.

default.0: Do you still need more time to defeat the #o8630010# and #o8630011# monsters? Well, you have to eliminate 300 of each, so it IS a tall order... Just hurry over to #b#m241000225# and #m241000224##k and defeat 300 #b#o8630010# and #o8630011# as soon as possible.
